comment: Read from the maker's source at commit e5f0e3d, the only commit carrying version 2.2.0. Two faults here are visible to a reader and are written into the lines. First, TrackAndField.cpp:39-40 calls configOutput(TF_OUTPUTA, "Output A") and then configOutput(TF_OUTPUTA, "Output B"): the first output is configured twice and the second is never configured at all. The second call overwrites the first, so hovering the upper output jack in Rack reads Output B, and the lower jack has no name and falls back to Rack's generic Output 2. The census carries exactly this, Output B on index 0 and an empty string on index 1. Second, TrackAndField.hpp declares schmittTriggerA, schmittTriggerB, white, the four cached input voltages, threshold and modeA/modeB at file scope rather than as members of the module, so every instance of the module in the patch shares them. The cached voltages and the mode integers are written at the top of each process() call and read within the same call, so those do no harm; the two Schmitt triggers hold state between calls and do, and a second copy of the module will corrupt the first one's edge detection. The noise is random::normal() scaled by 5 divided by the square root of 2, computed once per process() call at lines 52-53 and shared by both units. The panel prints SAMPLE, TRIGGER and OUTPUT, and marks the switch positions S AND H above and T AND H below; the two switch frames are res/NKK_2, a lever pointing up, at value 0, and res/NKK_0, a lever pointing down, at value 1, so up is sample and hold and matches the label above it. The status lamp brightness is set to the raw held voltage, so it is a crude level indicator rather than an on and off light. Every configured parameter and input is read in process().
